g.text: SCR08 — Settings and backends
Kotlin Compose screen definition · FR-KT-03 / persistent service / ADB · blueprint2.0 design only
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled · 10
Phone390dp: Single-column scrolling data/detail and48dp controls; preserve explicit draft fields on rotation. Modal drawer below840dp; persistent rail
at840dp+. Back returns previous detail, with Discard/Stay for dirty drafts. Landscape: Same IDs and authorization; wide layout only when available
width>=840dp; never shrink protected actions below48dp.
SCR08.C01 · Save with revision
Fields: Boot/listeners/roots/logging fields and expected config revision
SCR09 approves exact settings draft; CAS save desired config and applicable lifecycle changes
Failure: Conflict rejects entire draft; bind failure keeps desired vs actual separate
SCR08.C02 · Review pairing
Fields: ADB owner-enabled debugging prerequisites or separate MCP SCR11 enrollment
Open explicit ADB/MCP pairing review with exact selected profile
Failure: Self-ADB pairing grants no MCP permission; never changes device settings automatically
SCR08.C03 · Open navigation
Fields: SCR01..SCR08,SCR10,SCR11; protected review only via exact command
Open all local destinations through phone drawer or wide rail; Back returns previous screen
Failure: Dirty draft requires Discard/Stay; navigation never commits configuration
SCR08.C04 · Discard settings draft
Fields: Draft dirty fields and last config revision
Discard settings draft and restore committed configuration
Failure: No boot/listener/policy changes; active sockets remain until explicit lifecycle command
SCR08.C05 · Edit startup and MCP listener
Fields: Address/port,TLS identity,Origin allowlist,boot preference; bridge_config row_version for global audit reserve/journal capacity; never aliases
per-client logging_revision
Edit boot opt-in and authenticated loopback MCP listener draft
Failure: Unsupported FGS/TLS profile shows failure; Save needs exact SCR09 approval
SCR08.C06 · Edit same-device ADB profile
Fields: Pair endpoint/code from OS UI, separate discovered connect endpoint,device/user identity
Edit owner-paired same-device ADB access profile and initiate explicit pair/connect
Failure: Background/split-screen OS pairing constraints visible; wrong key/port never reports Connected
SCR08.C07 · Edit inbound ARC listener
Fields: Loopback port and root handle/security class; redacted management-readonly roots or explicitly registered ordinary_unprivileged roots;
SCR09/SCR11/secret overlays excluded
Edit inbound ARC listener and exact root/entry-point grants; management roots expose read-only redacted observation, never input/actions
Failure: Protected roots/secret surfaces not selectable; remote self-approval impossible
SCR08.C08 · Rotate inbound ARC credential
Fields: Principal/kind/revision and affected stream/input lease list
SCR09 approves exact inbound ARC credential rotation
Failure: Commit revokes old verifier/epoch; bind/session failures do not restore old bearer
SCR08.C09 · Inspect inbound controllers
Fields: Bound endpoint,principals,root,denied reasons and active stream/lease state
Inspect inbound ARC listener and connected controllers only
Failure: No ADB or outbound status inferred from this page
SCR08.C10 · Edit log quotas
Fields: Exact client_id and client_logging_config.logging_revision; mode/paused/retention/byte quota; global audit reserve is a read-only ceiling in
this editor
Open the same per-client logging editor; draft then exact SCR09 CAS save for this client only
Failure: Validation/CAS failure leaves both screens on prior committed policy
SCR08.C11 · Inspect ADB backend
Fields: Disconnected/pairing/connecting/connected/key-rejected; actual paired endpoint
Inspect ADB backend connection/identity and observed device facts
Failure: No socket proves MCP authority; reconnect is bounded and cannot retry uncertain device input
SCR08.C12 · Reload settings
Fields: Server values/local diff and required fresh approval
Reload current config revision after save conflict
Failure: Never silently rebases a credential/listener/root change
State definitions — exact enabled/disabled controls, effects and recovery
SCR08.S0 · Settings draft: committed revision visible
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Editor changes are not live until exact protected CAS save.
Recovery: Save through SCR09 or Discard; inspect actual listener/backend status separately.
SCR08.S1 · Waiting for unlock
Disabled: SCR08.C01, SCR08.C02, SCR08.C05, SCR08.C06, SCR08.C07, SCR08.C08, SCR08.C09, SCR08.C10, SCR08.C11
Effect: Credential-encrypted config/keys unavailable; minimal nonsecret boot flag only.
Recovery: Unlock normally then eligible local Start; no secret migration to device-protected storage.
SCR08.S2 · Foreground start ineligible
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Desired Running may be retained but listener is not ready; show Android reason.
Recovery: Owner fixes prerequisite then explicit eligible foreground Start; no automatic settings change.
SCR08.S3 · Settings revision conflict
Disabled: SCR08.C01, SCR08.C08
Effect: Exact CAS rejected all proposed fields; active listeners/config unchanged.
Recovery: Reload settings and compare draft before new SCR09 proof.
SCR08.S4 · ADB pairing/peer verification failed
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: No Connected state; stored keys/profile are not replaced without owner review.
Recovery: Inspect ADB reason and OS pairing endpoint; correct code/key/port then explicitly retry.
SCR08.S5 · Inbound ARC disabled
Disabled: SCR08.C08, SCR08.C09
Effect: No ARC socket, controllers or exposed root exists.
Recovery: Edit inbound listener then protected Save; MCP/ADB states remain independent.
SCR08.S6 · Inbound ARC ready
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Bound127.0.0.1 endpoint, ordinary root and authenticated controllers shown.
Recovery: Review controllers or disable/rotate via fresh exact owner Save; never implies ADB connected.
SCR08.S7 · ADB pairing in progress
Disabled: SCR08.C01, SCR08.C08
Effect: Owner-enabled Wireless Debugging pairing endpoint and code are transient; connect port is separate.
Recovery: Cancel pair or return to OS UI; split-screen/notification-assisted code retrieval is device-dependent.
SCR08.S8 · ADB connecting
Disabled: SCR08.C01, SCR08.C08
Effect: Paired identity exists; discovered connect endpoint is being verified.
Recovery: Timeout/key rejection returns disconnected; no device input is retried.
SCR08.S9 · ADB connected
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Paired endpoint/identity verified; metadata facts remain separately permission-qualified.
Recovery: Inspect health or intentionally disconnect profile; no MCP rule changed.
SCR08.S10 · ADB key rejected
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: TLS pairing identity not accepted; no fallback to unauthenticated5555.
Recovery: Owner explicitly re-pairs after checking device/profile; old identity retained until confirmed replacement.
